summary: Static, read-only, bounded search for CrossFire client/runtime artifacts that could consume model/piece, texture family, and WeaponShader CFG references. Result: BLOCKED_BY_MISSING_RUNTIME_ARTIFACTS. The local data/ corpus only contains REZ-extracted static assets (.ltb, .lta, .dtx, .tga, .cfg), FMOD audio banks, and CS:GO voice files. It does NOT contain CF client .exe / .dll / .rez / .pak / engine modules. No execution of unknown client binaries was attempted (only static / read-only inspection).

result.rationale: All consumer-side evidence in the local corpus has been exhausted: no CF client executable, no engine module, no .rez archive, no shader package, no weapon-format material/resource table. The only structural consumer evidence available is from the repo's own decoders (LithTechModelTextureConfigIndex, LithTechTextureMappingScanner, LithTechDatTextureReferenceIndex, CfgTextDecoder, LithTechModelDecoder), none of which is an engine-side consumer. Therefore the original CF runtime/resource system that consumes post_mesh_short_id, WeaponShader CFG, and the texture family cannot be located from the local corpus. Further progress requires either extracting and statically analyzing the original CF client, or obtaining another documented source for the engine binding contract. Per the continuation spec, this status MUST remain BLOCKED until direct/accepted Path-B evidence is established; the local executor is not authorized to flip closure to PASS or to any readiness-for-composition state.
